mapper.select: SELECT id, field_code, disaster_name, disaster_type, lon, lat, position, scale_grade, risk_grade FROM xian_disaster_hide WHERE ST_DWithin( ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(lon, lat), 4490), 4490), ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{centerLon}, #{centerLat}), 4490), 4490), #{radiusMeters} )
